title: Preventive/Detective Classification
prompt:
Preventive/Detective Classification — Is the control correctly classified as Preventive (stops an error/misstatement before it occurs) or Detective (identifies it after occurrence), based on its actual design?

Compare the recorded nature_of_control value to the control objective and description. Assess alignment as: Strong, Partial, or Weak.
- Strong: the recorded Preventive or Detective class matches how the control is actually designed.
- Partial: the design is mixed, so the recorded class is only partly right.
- Weak: the recorded class contradicts the actual design.

Return alignment, alignment_rationale (max 3 sentences), and proposed_solution (max 3 sentences). If the design text is too thin to judge, set status to insufficient_data.
